workarounds.symptom: Schematic writer turns `(wire …)` text inside quoted strings into real wires (writes through `_transactional_write_to_schematic_file`, and `sch_build_circuit`'s pre-write normalization); the count guard cannot see it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(schematic): keep quoted wire literals from becoming electrical connections. Target files: src/kicad_mcp/tools/schematic.py, tests/unit/test_schematic_wire_literal_safety.py. . KiCad schematic wire normalization previously scanned for `(wire` at **every character**, including inside quoted `text` nodes and symbol properties. A routine successful write could erase that user-authored value and turn its apparent wire S-expression into a real electrical net segment. The structural loss guard might not detect this sin... (Ref: https://github.com/oaslananka/kicad-mcp-pro/pull/1408)

workarounds.symptom: Writer-generated hexadecimal #PWR references are rejected by validation and block schematic writes
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(schematic): generate validator-safe power references. Target files: src/kicad_mcp/schematic/basic_authoring.py, src/kicad_mcp/schematic/connectivity_authoring.py, src/kicad_mcp/schematic/references.py. - Generate KiCad power references with decimal digits instead of raw hexadecimal UUID fragments. - Share one `power_reference_from_uuid()` helper between basic power-symbol authoring and connectivity power-terminal authoring. - Add regressions covering UUID prefixes containing `a-f`, including both writer paths. (Ref: https://github.com/oaslananka/kicad-mcp-pro/pull/890)
